text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Elevated 500 rate on /v1/generate in eu-west-1 starting ~1829456060. Error signature: "incompatible variant: expected chat, got embed_v2". Impact: multiple customers reporting failures (notably AcmeAds). Routing policy logs show fallback to embed variants.

marta: seeing the same in traces. root cause looks like a pinned model version mismatch for a few accounts — policy routing sent requests to a pinned variant that only implements embeddings.

jonah: paging oncall. @oncall-ml can you confirm if a recent rollout changed variant tags in model registry?

oncall-ml: I just picked up. Looking at model-catalog logs now. There was a rollout at 1829455800 that renamed variants for the new llm-suite: chat->chat_v2, embed->embed_v2 but some customers still pinned old numeric refs. Might be a tag alias collision.

samir: hmm, this smells like the smart-routing fallback logic: when pinned model is incompatible, we should not fall back to an embedding variant — should pick a gen/chat-compatible variant or fail fast.

liz: customer impact? Alex, any tickets?

alex: support queue has 6 escalations for AcmeAds and 2 for BetaNews. They see immediate 500s on chat endpoints; they sent logs showing responses with "variant=embed_v2" header then error.

marta: Mitigation idea: 1) temporarily disable auto-fallback to variants with mismatched capability tags in eu-west-1 routing policy (fast). 2) roll back the alias change in model-catalog if safe. Which is faster?

jonah: disabling auto-fallback is a config flip in routing service — takes ~2 min to deploy and propagate. Rolling back alias requires catalog write and sync; could be slower and risky for other customers.

oncall-ml: I'll flip the routing policy to strict-match (no cross-variant fallback) in eu-west-1. Deploying now.

deploy-bot: deploy started: routing-service config update by oncall-ml (change: fallback_policy=STRICT_MATCH) — build 2103 -> rolling to eu-west-1 nodes.

samir: if we flip to strict-match we might increase 404s for some customers who rely on fallback. Prepare a message to support so they can inform affected customers about transient 404 vs 500 behavior.

oncall-ml: routing flip complete on eu-west-1. Observability: 500 rate for /v1/generate dropped from 18% -> 2% in 5m. 404s increased from 0.1% -> 1.8%.

marta: good. Can we identify which pinned refs are wrong so we can patch customers? Add a query to model-registry: list pins where pinned_variant.capability != endpoint.capability for last 30d.

samir: running query now. Result: 7 accounts pinned to legacy numeric refs that map to embed-only models while they call chat/generate endpoints. Example: account 3482 pinned ref "mdl-2023-109:v3" -> maps to embed_v2.

alex: contacting AcmeAds support with mitigation notes: telling them we'll update pins for them if they approve — ETA 30m.

liz: escalate for contractual impact? SLA hit?

marta: check logs for token-level billing anomalies. If requests failed with 500 they may have been retried by client; need to calculate exposed traffic.

oncall-ml: doing quick SLO calc — estimate 0.6% request-level SLA impact for eu-west-1 across affected endpoints in the 45m window. I'll post the exact numbers to the incident board.

samir: patch plan: for each mismatched pin, either 1) remap the pin to closest chat-capable variant (safe) or 2) update customer pin to explicit chat variant after consent. For high-impact customers do (1) with internal rollback.

jonah: approve remap for critical customers (AcmeAds, BetaNews) to reduce outages immediately. Make sure remap writes a migration audit log and notifies customers.

marta: I'll coordinate the remap. Steps: a) create remap mapping in model-catalog (alias: mdl-2023-109:v3 -> chat_v2 compatible variant), b) update routing-service cache, c) watch errors. Doing step a now.

deploy-bot: catalog update queued by marta (change: alias add) — will propagate to eu-west-1 edge caches in ~90s.

oncall-ml: remap propagated. Observability: errors for AcmeAds chat endpoint fell to near zero. Confirming no adverse effects on embed-only customers.

samir: double-check that we didn't inadvertently route embed-only clients to chat models (that could increase latency/cost). Query live routing logs for affected account ids.

marta: routing logs show remapped requests for account 3482 now target chat_v2 variant and have similar latency to previous chat traffic. Cost delta negligible.

alex: customers updated and happy for now, but they asked for root cause and prevention plan.

jonah: immediate next actions: 1) add a strict validation at pin-time in model-registry to block pins that map mismatched capability to endpoint; 2) add unit tests for routing fallback to prevent fallback to incompatible variants; 3) run a scan across all accounts for bad pins and schedule migrations. Prioritize automated remap for accounts with high error signals.

oncall-ml: I'll own the runtime flipback plan and add an alert that fires when fallback_target.capability != request_capability.

marta: I'll own registry validation + migration script. Samir, can you write the fallback test?

samir: on it. Will open PR, add test matrix for chat/gen/embed mismatches and ensure fallback code returns 422 instead of silently routing to incompatible variant.

liz: postmortem expectations: timeline, root cause (alias/tag collision during catalog rollout), blast radius (list of accounts), mitigation steps, long-term fixes. Add customer-impact section and exec summary.

alex: support will send templated customer message with apology, explanation, actions taken, and offer to coordinate pin changes.

jonah: setting incident severity to Sev2 (customer-facing outage but mitigated). Logging incident in tracker.

incident-bot: Incident updated: severity=2, status=mitigated, incident_id=INC-2026-728.

marta: closing notes: no data exfiltration, no pricing mismatch, root cause is model aliasing + permissive fallback. Follow-ups assigned: marta (registry validation + migration) ; samir (fallback tests + code change); oncall-ml (alert + routing invariant); alex (customer comms).

jonah: thanks team. I'll run a morning follow-up with execs. :white_check_mark:

oncall-ml: last_message: monitoring holds at normal levels for 45m. Closing channel in 2h unless regression. :lock:
